notes: This file is a static framework draft only. It is not loaded by /cloud yet.
Existing originalHome -> coffeeCorner -> lapClose side branch is preserved and is not moved under nestAtlas.
nestAtlas is the future top-level map / hub selector placeholder, not a concrete explorable city.
Future top-level hubs are reserved only. They should not force current scenes to move.
Shortcut entries from originalHome should be added later as explicit dock/hotspot config, not as early usage-tier fields.

actionTypes.go: Direct navigation to a target scene/hub. Does not imply a deep-drill stack push.
actionTypes.push: Enter a deeper nested scene from a hotspot. Adds current scene to sceneStack.
actionTypes.jumpTo: Navigation panel anchor jump to a known root/hub scene.
actionTypes.openPanel: Open a navigation or management panel.

originalHome.directorNote: First drawn home image and default opening facade. Keep current home behavior intact. Future world access starts from leftDock.

coffeeCorner.directorNote: Current coffee corner remains a direct rightDock branch from originalHome. Do not move it under nestAtlas just because future hubs exist.

lapClose.directorNote: Lap visual flow is viable, but current patch controller must not connect to main /cloud as-is. Reconnect only through sceneRouter/sceneStack.

nestAtlas.directorNote: Top-level map / category selector placeholder. It is not the same as nestCity.

dreamHub.directorNote: Experimental scenes and one-off images: newspaper style, illustration style, 2D, dreamlike formats.

lifeHub.directorNote: Daily-life and date scene groups for future additions. Existing coffeeCorner is not automatically moved here.

privateHub.directorNote: Nest management, records, memory/archive areas, and kitten's own places.

storyHub.directorNote: Playful roleplay/story setups such as doctor, athlete, alternate roles, and story-book style scenes. Replaces earlier roleplayHub naming.

nestCity.directorNote: Constructed explorable nest-world area with object interaction: secret garden, magic stone entrance, love stone, restaurant, newsstand, camera area, vendors, etc. It is not the top-level atlas.

futureHub.directorNote: One top-level future bucket is enough for now. If it grows, split inside this hub later instead of pre-allocating many empty top-level hubs.

navPanelDraft.note: No full breadcrumb UI for now. Navigation panel should expose major anchors only.

assetAdminDraft.note: Future asset admin should allow upload/preview/set-current and automatic version bump by assetKey. This belongs to assetController/admin, not sceneRouter.
